name: Google Gemini
tagline: Google AI assistant bundled with Gemini Advanced and Google AI Pro

pricing.notes: Official Google subscriptions page checked 2026-07-30; Google AI Pro listed at $19.99/month.

verdictSummary: A chat UI is easy, but Gemini's model access, Google ecosystem integration, multimodality, storage tie-ins, and platform distribution are not solo-buildable.
coreLoopDIY: Build a multi-model chat app with document upload and optional Google API integrations.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay for model access and Google-native placement, not because chat UIs are hard.

priorArt.name: Open WebUI
priorArt.desc: Open-source self-hosted chat UI for model APIs and local models.

notes: Completes the model-platform set; useful comparison for structural no verdicts.
